FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.

2. When practising Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li.

3. When practising Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.

6. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Excuse me
   B. Thank you
   C. Good morning / hello
   D. Good night only

7. When practising Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking.

8. When practising Oral expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)

10. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. livre
   B. chaise
   C. fenêtre
   D. porte
